name: iris-cure-form-dev
description: CA/CR treatment form ingestion, multi-template generation, responsive migration, review, deployment planning, verification, and rollback orchestration.
defaultPrompt: Initialize CA/CR cure form development support
Ingest this hospital Word, PDF, or Excel form requirement
Split this Excel requirement into approved template boundaries and generate a read-only intake report
Create a CA treatment assessment form from the approved cure form specification
Create a CR treatment record form from the approved cure form specification
Make this existing CA/CR server form responsive without breaking its runtime contract
Generate and verify a complete HISUI browser preview for these cure form changes
Prepare and validate the required manual interaction test evidence for a new cure form
Prepare a dry-run cure form deployment package and review its impact
Consolidate an accepted existing-form grey template back to its formal RowID and verify zero grey references
Verify or roll back a cure form deployment operation
